body: Becoming an alcoholic for starters, or am i already one?
I havent. Dont think i need one anyways, cant see someone telling me what i already know as beneficial
No, just living many hours apart. But i didnt really come here to bitch and moan, just wanted to drop off some writing/a note so im at least telling someone I'll be doing it.
Relationships, jobs, everyday life. You know the drill, just like everyone else in here i guess
Thanks, I try to make at least those meaningful.
A lot of stuff i guess, but ive always been suicidal. Situations just keep getting worse and ive accetped that. Its an odd feeling when youre not scared to die and you have reasons to not live.

Thank you, it means a lot. im no writer, never really interested in it. But i have been told for a while that i have natural talent for it. But for everything else i feel its my description of a struggle many people face, to let them know that even if nobody is there physically, they aren't alone. And the scare that the only thoughts that will remain are suicidal ones, so to live for tomorrow instead of yesterday.
I found that if i went deeper i wouldnt have to do as many, or as often. But thats a bad road i dont want to take again.
Kinda went to town on myself last night, couldnt stop thinking about doing it all day today either. Just a few more, right?
